A San Francisco playgirl (Tippi Hedren) follows a bachelor (Rod Taylor) to Bodega Bay where, for no apparent reason, flocks of birds begin killing the populace.
programme.title: The Birds

programme.desc: A barmaid, a Bostonian and an Indian (Rita Gam) flirt with an artist (Scott Brady) in 18th-century upstate New York.
programme.title: Mohawk

programme.desc: A spy and the FBI hunt a petty thief (Richard Widmark) who has lifted microfilm from a woman's (Jean Peters) purse.
programme.title: Pickup on South Street

programme.desc: Count Alucard comes out of a lake in his coffin and makes a Southern belle his bride.
programme.title: Son of Dracula

programme.desc: Dagwood (Arthur Lake) gets Blondie (Penny Singleton) a fur coat after his old girlfriend (Rita Hayworth) comes to town.
programme.title: Blondie on a Budget

programme.desc: A group of Allied soldiers are intent on breaking out, not only to escape, but also to draw Nazi forces away from battle to search for fugitives. Among the prisoners are American Captain Virgil Hilts and British Squadron Leader Roger Bartlett.
programme.title: The Great Escape

programme.desc: Slapstick comedy from Larry, Moe, Curly and occasionally Shemp.
programme.title: The Three Stooges

programme.desc: S01 E24 — Follow That Man After a few mysterious phone calls, Mr. Dithers suspects Dagwood is embezzling money from his company, and he hires a detective to get to the bottom of things.
programme.title: Blondie

programme.desc: An eccentric pianist (Burgess Meredith) invades a couple's (Merle Oberon, Melvyn Douglas) home and marriage.
programme.title: That Uncertain Feeling

programme.desc: Love blooms between a sympathetic attorney and the comely shoplifter he has taken home for the Christmas holiday.
programme.title: Remember the Night

programme.desc: A baby photographer (Bob Hope) plays private eye to help a woman (Dorothy Lamour) find her uncle, kidnapped by a master criminal (Peter Lorre).
programme.title: My Favorite Brunette

programme.desc: Rupert, a dancing squirrel, is left to fend for himself on the streets after his master turns bankrupt; unsuited for the hard life, Rupert devises a scheme to raise his master's family from poverty.
programme.title: The Great Rupert

programme.desc: International swindlers are diverted from their sinister dealings when an explosion wrecks the ship they are aboard.
programme.title: Beat the Devil

programme.desc: An exile (John Richardson) from a hostile tribe woos a woman (Raquel Welch) from a gentle tribe amid monsters and an earthquake.
programme.title: One Million Years B.C.

programme.desc: One-eyed Marshal "Rooster" Cogburn (John Wayne) and a Texas Ranger (Glen Campbell) help a girl (Kim Darby) find her father's killer.
programme.title: True Grit

programme.desc: During the Civil War, reports of a sea monster attacking ships alarm the Navy. An investigation finds the monster is a submarine, the "Nautilus," commanded by vengeance-seeking Capt. Nemo (Allen Holubar), who was once an Indian prince.
programme.title: 20,000 Leagues Under the Sea

programme.desc: Two vaudeville guys (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) turn deep-sea divers and save a treasure belonging to a Polynesian princess (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Bali

programme.desc: In a Nazi prison barracks, other POWs believe that a cynical American sergeant (William Holden) is an informer.
programme.title: Stalag 17

programme.desc: Agents of heaven and hell fight for Little Joe's (Eddie "Rochester" Anderson) soul after his wife (Ethel Waters) gets him a pardon.
programme.title: Cabin in the Sky

programme.desc: A man in black (Yul Brynner) recruits six hired guns to lead Mexican villagers against the gang of an outlaw (Eli Wallach).
programme.title: The Magnificent Seven

programme.desc: The outlaw (Wendell Corey) tries to kill an insurance agent (Bob Hope) who has been mistaken for him in order to collect on a big policy.
programme.title: Alias Jesse James

programme.desc: When former business partners Dean and Jerry enlist in the Army, they have different ambitions. Martin wants to see action. Klutzy Lewis wants to stay out of combat. They both have to deal with stern Army personnel while preparing for a variety show.
programme.title: At War With the Army

programme.desc: A Greek slave (Victor Mature) entrusted with Christ's robe must play gladiator for Emperor Caligula and Messalina.
programme.title: Demetrius and the Gladiators

programme.desc: A presidential candidate's daughter (Merle Oberon) poses as her own maid and dates a rodeo cowboy (Gary Cooper) in Palm Beach.
programme.title: The Cowboy and the Lady

programme.desc: The miserly head (Brian Donlevy) of a Hollywood studio hires a goofy paperhanger (Jerry Lewis) to spy on his employees.
programme.title: The Errand Boy

programme.desc: A racetrack tout (Bob Hope) has a month to pay back the sum a gangster (Lloyd Nolan) lost on a bad tip.
programme.title: The Lemon Drop Kid

programme.desc: The world's richest man (Peter Sellers) and the world's poorest orphan (Ringo Starr) set out to prove every man has his price.
programme.title: The Magic Christian

programme.desc: A blind private eye (Edward Arnold) with a guide dog probes a murder for a friend (Ann Harding) and finds a Nazi spy ring.
programme.title: Eyes in the Night

programme.desc: A librarian hears a sour note when a charming rogue convinces Iowa townspeople to start a boys marching band.
programme.title: The Music Man

programme.desc: The judge's (Lewis Stone) son (Mickey Rooney) goes to college after serving in the war and finds his sweetheart (Bonita Granville) is engaged to someone else.
programme.title: Love Laughs at Andy Hardy

programme.desc: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.
programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner

programme.desc: A lawyer (Ginger Rogers) bails out and then marries a Hollywood tough guy (Jack Carson) who's a milquetoast in real life.
programme.title: The Groom Wore Spurs

programme.desc: A goofy astronaut (Don Knotts) with a fear of heights becomes assistant janitor, then goes on a space mission.
programme.title: The Reluctant Astronaut

programme.desc: The jazz trombonist (James Stewart) marries his sweetheart (June Allyson), forms a band and creates his signature sound.
programme.title: The Glenn Miller Story

programme.desc: Moe, Larry and Curly Joe circle the globe with Phileas Fogg III and his girlfriend.
programme.title: The Three Stooges Go Around the World in a Daze

programme.desc: A music professor (Ryan O'Neal) visits San Francisco with his fiancée (Madeline Kahn) and meets a kooky woman (Barbra Streisand).
programme.title: What's Up, Doc?

programme.desc: Two buddies win a car and head for Hollywood to meet Anita Ekberg.
programme.title: Hollywood or Bust

programme.desc: The mythical Greek hero (Reg Park) rescues a maiden left at the mercy of a beast and goes on to save his son from the sexist queen of lost Atlantis (Fay Spain).
programme.title: Hercules and the Captive Women

programme.desc: Two Wild West con men (John Astin, Steve Carlson) ride into a Colorado town, unaware it sits on a fortune in ore.
programme.title: The Brothers O'Toole

programme.desc: One-eyed Marshal "Rooster" Cogburn (John Wayne) and a Texas Ranger (Glen Campbell) help a girl (Kim Darby) find her father's killer.
programme.title: True Grit

programme.desc: Wolf Benson is a ruthless outlaw in search of a new identity. After chucking innocent cowboy Gene Autry off a train, he steals Gene's luggage and takes on his identity before continuing on a murderous and merciless crime spree.
programme.title: Oh, Susanna
